lethal_rejection_points: 1. 'The authors claim an AI-driven digital twin, but the codebase contains neither machine learning models nor physical sensor telemetry. What justifies this terminology?'
2. 'How does this work differ substantially from Boswell et al. (J. Chem. Educ. 2013), who already published an interactive web HPLC simulator with empirical calibration?'
3. 'Where are the experimental validation chromatograms? A simulation without rigorous comparison against certified reference standards is merely a mathematical demonstration.'
4. 'The retention time prediction relies on empirical logP correlations rather than experimentally measured k_w and S parameters. The claimed accuracy of +/-10-20% is untested.'
5. 'If this is an educational tool, where is the human-subjects educational outcome data (pre/post-test scores, cohort control vs experimental group, normalized gain g)?'
